changes.evidence: In the S5 finale 'The End' (episode 110) May leaves S.H.I.E.L.D. to spend Coulson's last days with him in Tahiti (the record's own step says so, status Retired). After he dies she returns as Mack's second in command (S6). No stage records the S5 departure; the S6 S.H.I.E.L.D. stage is the return.
Once the Chronicom Colonization is over (S7 finale), Fitz and Simmons retire from S.H.I.E.L.D. to raise Alya. In the one-year-later reunion they are 'retired' and no longer agents.

This is the same person as A:st-leo-fitz. The twin's own S7 step says Fitz retires with Simmons and Alya. The wiki agrees: Fitz and Simmons retire from S.H.I.E.L.D. after the Chronicom war (S7 finale).
Once the Chronicom Colonization is over (S7 finale), Simmons and Fitz retire from S.H.I.E.L.D. In the one-year-later reunion Mack won't share classified details because 'she was no longer an agent'.

In S2 'Scars' (episode 42), Mack learns Coulson will stay Director, quits S.H.I.E.L.D. and hands in his badge. He returns to the Iliad only to collect his things, fights the Inhumans there, and in 'S.O.S. Part Two' (S2 finale) Coulson talks him into rejoining.

Late in S3 (Hive arc), the Secret Warriors fall under suspicion of serving Hive and Coulson disbands them. Elena demands to walk away from S.H.I.E.L.D. and leaves. Later in S3 she is convinced to return once she learns Daisy was Hive's slave. The return happens in S3, so it replaces the S.H.I.E.L.D. stage at Slingshot, which only repeated the group she was already in.

His British Army (SAS) service ended before the show: by S2 episode 1 he is already a mercenary for hire on Isabelle Hartley's team. He never belongs to the British Army during any title he's on file for.

In the S2 finale 'S.O.S.' Lincoln turns against Jiaying and Afterlife falls. At the start of S3 he has shunned the Inhumans and works as an ER doctor at Cincinnati Memorial Hospital, refusing Daisy's offers. He joins S.H.I.E.L.D. only later in S3. No stage records him leaving Afterlife.

In S5 (2091), Deke becomes one of the True Believers, the wiki's 'Becoming a True Believer' section; the infobox lists True Believers (formerly). Back in 2018 he helps S.H.I.E.L.D. without joining, and in the S5 finale he leaves the Lighthouse behind. In S6 he runs his own tech company, Deke Shaw's Company, until Sarge's attack forces him back, and Mack officially makes him an agent. His S7 alternate-timeline directorship stays covered by the S.H.I.E.L.D. stage.

In S3, after the Hive-suspicion lockdown, the Secret Warriors are disbanded. Joey says he wants to leave S.H.I.E.L.D. as soon as possible, and once he is cleared he goes home, 'turning his back on the Secret Warriors for good and returning to his former life'. The infobox has S.H.I.E.L.D. (formerly).

In S1, after the pilot, Mike trains at a S.H.I.E.L.D. facility and joins Coulson's team on the Bus ('The Bridge', episode 10). The Centipede/Garrett faction then captures him and makes him Deathlok. In the S1 finale (Battle at Cybertek) he turns on Garrett and turns down Skye's offer to join Coulson's team. He joins Coulson's S.H.I.E.L.D. in S2. The twin T:st-deathlok already has the S1 departure.

owner_calls.question: After the S2 finale May takes indefinite 'time off' from S.H.I.E.L.D.: she empties her locker, stays away for months and says she may not go back. She comes back in S3 'Among Us Hide...'. Should this count as a departure, given the record already has a second S.H.I.E.L.D. stage at S3?
options: Keep as is (leave of absence, not a departure)
Add ['Independent','Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2'] after the S1 S.H.I.E.L.D. stage
owner_calls.evidence: The wiki calls it 'Time Off from S.H.I.E.L.D.': Coulson approves a timeout, and May tells Andrew 'What would you say if I didn't go back to S.H.I.E.L.D.?'. She returns in S3 episode 4.

owner_calls.question: Late in S3 (Hive arc, through the finale), Hive takes control of Daisy. She defects to his side, kills Malick, steals the Kree beacon and Terrigen for him and attacks Mack, until she is freed. Record it as a stage?
options: Keep as is (mind control, not a choice)
Add a Hive's-faction / HYDRA stage at S3 between The Secret Warriors and Independent
owner_calls.evidence: The wiki's 'Betraying Her Allies' section. Bucky's infobox lists HYDRA '(formerly, brainwashed)', but Daisy's infobox does not list a Hive affiliation.

owner_calls.question: In S5 (2091), Deke sells Daisy to Kasius, who imprisons her as one of his Inhuman fighters until the escape from the Lighthouse. Record the captivity?
options: Add a Kree/Kasius captivity stage at S5, then S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
owner_calls.evidence: The wiki's 'Imprisoned by Kasius' and 'Escape from the Lighthouse' sections cover several S5 episodes.

owner_calls.question: In S5 (2091), Kasius keeps Simmons as his servant (with an ear implant) until she and Fitz break free. Record the captivity?
options: Add a Kree/Kasius captivity stage at S5, then S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
owner_calls.evidence: The wiki's 'Meeting Kasius' and 'Released and Engaged' sections cover several S5 episodes.

owner_calls.question: In S5, after the team vanishes, the U.S. Air Force arrests Fitz and holds him at Blue Raven Ridge for about 6 months, until Hunter breaks him out. Record the detention?
options: Add a U.S. Air Force custody stage at S5, then S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
owner_calls.evidence: The wiki's 'Arrest and Escape' section says he was held at Blue Raven Ridge 'for 6 months'.

owner_calls.question: In S3, after S.H.I.E.L.D. contains Lash, Malick's HYDRA takes him. He escapes and spends about a month on the run from both S.H.I.E.L.D. and HYDRA, then surrenders to S.H.I.E.L.D. The same applies to the twin T:st-lash. Record it?
options: Main: add ['HYDRA',S3],['Independent',S3],['S.H.I.E.L.D.',S3]. Twin Lash: add the same after its S3 S.H.I.E.L.D. stage
owner_calls.evidence: The wiki's lead says he was 'briefly captured by Hydra before then escaping and going on the run'. See also the 'In Hydra's Hands' and 'Completed Transition' sections.

owner_calls.question: In S4 the Watchdogs/Superior capture Mace, and Aida replaces him with an LMD and locks his real body into the Framework. He dies there as the Resistance leader and never returns to S.H.I.E.L.D. Is the final S.H.I.E.L.D. S4 stage after The Framework's Resistance correct?
options: Keep as is (his real-world group stays S.H.I.E.L.D.)
Drop the final S.H.I.E.L.D. stage so the record ends on The Framework's Resistance
owner_calls.evidence: The wiki's 'Left to Die' section: he is replaced by an LMD and locked into the Framework on the Ivanov Oil Platform. The 'Heroic Sacrifice' section: he dies inside the Framework.
